bugs_summary.description: customer_consents_count=0 and policy_accepted_at=null in final state despite policy being accepted on T3. The agent recorded policy_accepted=true internally and book tool received policy_accepted=true, but the customer_consents audit table row and policy_accepted_at column were not populated. This is a pre-existing known issue documented in earlier holistic runs.

notes: Seed store note: Redis Store (LangGraph InMemoryStore / async store client) was unavailable during the ephemeral seed container run (--no-deps mode). Memories were written to Customer.metadata_['memories'] in PostgreSQL (DB fallback path). The running agent container reads memories from this fallback path when the store is empty, which is why the bot correctly resolved the customer profile on T1. Memory resolution worked correctly despite not going through the Redis store primary path.
